39072.description:
In ancient times, all of Nuia was ruled by a people known as Nuons. They did not live in peace, however: they were at constant war with the dragons. The dragons worshipped their leader, |ni;Misagon|r, as a kind of living god. It was not until the Nuons could defeat Misagon, the largest and most powerful dragon, that the war finally ended. 
Years later, Elven researchers discovered that some of |ni;Misagon's Scales|r had survived, and could be found throughout the Karkasse Ridgelands. They even retained some of their former magic, and have been rare, highly sought-after artifacts every since. 

|ni;Lunascales never fail to socket.|r

9001301.description:
In ancient times, all of Nuia was ruled by a people known as Nuons. They did not live in peace, however: they were at constant war with the dragons. The dragons worshipped their leader, |ni;Misagon|r, as a kind of living god. It was not until the Nuons could defeat Misagon, the largest and most powerful dragon, that the war finally ended. 
Years later, Elven researchers discovered that some of |ni;Misagon's Scales|r had survived, and could be found throughout the Karkasse Ridgelands. They even retained some of their former magic, and have been rare, highly sought-after artifacts every since.
